objective: a 3-touch abandoned cart flow with email and SMS

trigger.definition: checkout_started occurred, then 1 hour(s) without order_completed
trigger.source_object: checkout_started sent to Klaviyo in real time, carrying in_holdout

entry_filters.condition: is identified (has an email address on the profile); anonymous checkout_started events cannot enter
has not done order_completed in the 1 hour(s) after checkout_started
not in the program-wide global holdout (bucket of md5(user_id || ':lmm_global') under 5)

the trigger is the person's own activity in the last day (a checkout, a product view, an order), which counts as engagement; anyone with no click, reply, order or session in 365 days is still excluded

ongoing_filters.condition: has not done order_completed since entering
can receive email marketing (subscribed, not bounced, not sunset-suppressed)

suppressions: unsubscribed from marketing email, or hard bounced
marked any message as spam (complaint), ever
sunset-suppressed (lcm_sunset is true); only a fresh opt-in lifts it
currently in a higher-priority flow (by the frequency policy's flow_priority: billing, cart, post-purchase first)

holdout.assignment: persistent, by user: bucket = first 7 hex digits of md5(user_id || ':northfield_coffee_cart_abandon_1h') mod 100; bucket < 10 is the holdout, added as in_holdout to the live checkout_started event by the system that sends it; holdout members enter, then exit at holdout_split, so both arms are the same population
holdout.sizing: about 351 entrants a month (ESTIMATE), 31.3% return within 10 days with no flow (ESTIMATE), 20% relative lift (6.3 pts) worth acting on: 508 holdout entrants at 10%, 14.5 months of entries plus the 10-day outcome window, so the read lands about 14.8 months after launch (engine/measurement/stats.py feasible --entries-per-month 350.7 --holdout 0.1 --baseline 0.3132 --mde-rel 0.2 --outcome-window-days 10)

frequency.cap: at most 4 email/sms/push message(s) per week; at most 1 sms message(s) per day across flows (Smart Sending)

branch.condition: in_holdout is true (property on the checkout_started trigger event, set by the system that sends it)

steps.message: cart reminder: Their cart, exactly as they left it (the product block), with one button back to checkout. No offer.
cart objection: Answer the most common reason people stop at checkout (shipping cost, delivery time, returns), with the cart below.
cart objection (email version): Answer the most common reason people stop at checkout (shipping cost, delivery time, returns), with the cart below.
cart last call: A last, short reminder that the cart is saved; the offer only if the offer policy allows one, and a deadline only if the offer has one.

measurement.primary_metric: placed an order (order_completed) within 10 days of entry, treatment vs holdout, both arms counted from their entry date
measurement.read_after: not inside 12 months at this volume (it would take about 15 months): keep the holdout, report against a pre/post baseline, and label every result directional
guardrails: spam complaint rate per send below 0.1% (Gmail's target; 0.3% is its hard limit)
unsubscribe rate per send, against the 90-day median for your lifecycle sends; pause a touch running above twice it
SMS opt-out rate per send, against your SMS program's median

data_dependencies.name: checkout_started
data_dependencies.note: qualifies a person for the flow; 3528 events from 1281 people

data_dependencies.name: order_completed
data_dependencies.note: the core action: entry clock, exit and primary metric; orders table (the transaction object): 1280 completed orders, 693 people

data_dependencies.name: email
data_dependencies.note: address for every email touch; users.email filled 100%

data_dependencies.name: sms_consent
data_dependencies.note: SMS consent with an auditable record (10DLC); users.sms_consent_at filled 17%

data_dependencies.name: in_holdout
data_dependencies.note: a property on the checkout_started event, added where it is sent (formula in the build steps)

data_dependencies.name: lcm_sunset
data_dependencies.note: suppression flag the sunset step writes; create the property in the platform before launch
